description: This PHP file defines an interface `ValueXModifiable` within the `OrangeHRM\Core\Report\FilterField` namespace. The interface declares a method `xValueModifier` intended for implementing custom modifications to a value `x` for persistence purposes in the context of the OrangeHRM system. It is part of the report filtering system, specifically related to modifiable filter field values.

methods.name: xValueModifier
methods.description: Defines how the `x` value should be prepared for persisting, allowing implementation to modify the input value or handle nulls.
